title: Quantity can go down to zero and below
hint: Keep pressing minus longer than seems reasonable.
explanation: The counter has no lower bound. A negative quantity reduces the order total.

title: The +/- buttons have no accessible name
hint: What will a screen reader user hear on the quantity buttons?
explanation: The buttons contain only SVG icons and no aria-label. A screen reader announces them as just "button".

title: A long product name overlaps the neighbouring columns
hint: Look closely at the longest name in the list.
explanation: The name has white-space: nowrap with no truncation or wrapping, so the text spills out of its column.

title: "Remove" deletes the first item in the list, not the selected one
hint: Remove an item that is not in the first row.
explanation: The handler always removes the first array element instead of the item with the clicked id.

title: The promo code is case-sensitive: sale10 is rejected
hint: Type the promo code the way a normal person would.
explanation: The code is compared strictly, without normalising the case. The user sees "Promo code not found" for a valid code.

title: One promo code can be applied many times, discounts stack
hint: How many times can you press "Apply"?
explanation: Every apply adds another 10%. Ten clicks make the order free, after that the total goes negative.

title: The subtotal shows a floating point error (51.400000000000006 €)
hint: Look closely at the number in the "Items" row.
explanation: Money is summed as floats and shown without formatting. Count money in cents or round on output.

title: At exactly 50 € delivery is still charged, although it is free "from 50 €"
hint: Build a cart worth exactly the threshold amount.
explanation: The condition is subtotal > 50 instead of subtotal >= 50. A classic boundary value mistake.

title: The total does not include the delivery cost
hint: Add up the summary rows by hand.
explanation: Total = items - discount. Delivery is displayed but never added to the amount to pay.

title: An order can be placed with an empty cart
hint: What happens if you remove everything and still press "Checkout"?
explanation: Checkout does not check that the cart has items. An empty 0 € order is created.

title: The cart counter in the header does not update after removing an item
hint: Watch the shop header while changing the cart in different ways.
explanation: The counter is recalculated only when the quantity changes. Removing an item does not touch it.
